notes: A.1 item 149 — the consistency rules for feature-name-1 when the clause is used with an external file connector, conditionally required on feature-name-1 existing. Since kb/Work PB5844 it exists (item 150: BINARY-SEQUENTIAL, LINE-SEQUENTIAL), so the rule is specified in docs/CONFORMANCE.md §7: two entries that write the clause agree only when they write the same arm (§2023:12.4.5.3 GR1c, "Either the STANDARD-1 phrase or a consistent value of feature-name-1"), so STANDARD-1 disagrees with each name and the two names with each other; an entry that writes no clause agrees with every arm, having the implementor's method, which BINARY-SEQUENTIAL names and the declined STANDARD-1 leaves in force (kb/Work PB5311). The relation is not transitive, so it is checked for every pair: at compile time by ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check over FileEntryIdentity.Segments (COBOL6847) and at run time by ExternalDescriptor.RecordDelimitersAgree (EC-EXTERNAL-FILE-MISMATCH), one relation for both. Review R1-1 of the PB5844 branch found the first draft mapping STANDARD-1, BINARY-SEQUENTIAL and an omitted clause to one value; ExternalFileEntryIdentityTests and the 1985 refusal pb5844_rd_external_specs_differ_85 pin the disagreements, An_omitted_clause_is_its_implementor_value and pb5311-external-reserve-and-delimiter-defaults the agreement.
